close_reason: Done and superseded. The confirming review over the RC-11 repairs ran as RD-1 (REVISE, three blocking findings, all repaired) and was itself confirmed by two independent RD-1b reviews over the repaired digest 7f823aa3, both REVISE. notes: RC-11 ran 2026-08-06 over the exact bytes act 1 binds; VERDICT: REVISE (raw at round-2026-08b/reviews/RC-11-repair-confirming-RAW.md).
